title: Research ideas
description: research/runs/<date>/ideas.json: the ranked ideas for one research run. The video styles read this file, so its shape is fixed. An idea's n is its rank, and 'number 2' always means n 2 in the latest run.

n.description: the idea's rank as a whole number, starting at 1 with no gaps

title.description: a short title for the video, in plain words

angle.description: one sentence on the way the video takes the topic

why.description: one or two sentences on why this idea and why now, with the numbers behind it

format.description: the shape of the video, such as Tutorial, Listicle, Breakdown or Opinion

evidence.description: a list of the watched videos or posts behind the idea, each with its address, its creator and its outlier score (0 for a source that has no score, such as an X post)

url.description: a web link starting with https:// or http://

outlier.description: the video's outlier score from items.json, or 0 when it has none

hooks.description: a list of opening lines for the video, best first
